text:
Priya: Quick check — can someone give eyes on PR #21041? Need to land before the infra maintenance tomorrow 15:00 PT. mac-e2e is flaky; CI failing on `chrome-launch` step. Tagging @Tom @Marta @Alex :eyes:
Tom: On it. Starting a rerun for the mac matrix now.
CI-bot: Re-run started for PR #21041 — mac-e2e job id: 8421. Queue position 2.
Tom: Looks like failure reproduces locally on mac-12 sim. I can try a targeted retry of the failing job (`ci rerun --job mac-e2e --pr 21041`).
Marta: I left two small review comments — one test assertion and one whitespace nit. Nothing blocking.
Priya: Thanks @Marta — I'll push a follow-up commit for the test fix in ~15m.
Alex: Heads up: there's a rebase window for tomorrow at 17:00 UTC (coord with release folks). If you can't get green before infra window we should consider delaying the landing until after the maintenance to avoid churn.
Priya: If rerun + fix don't green before window, can we do a canary-only landing to staging to validate? We can set rollout flag and avoid full prod deploy.
Usman: Agree with canary. Also if it stays flaky, we can pin to the previous model and roll back without a full rollback of other changes. But landing into staging requires QA eyes — @Sofia can you help if needed?
Sofia: Yep, can help with the staging canary verification after you land.
Tom: Rerun completed: mac-e2e passed 2/3, failing on `chrome-launch` again with `Timed out waiting for browser`. I'm attaching the failing log snippet: ```[ERROR] puppeteer.launch: Timeout after 30s```
Priya: Hmm. That error started appearing after the last test infra bump. I'm going to revert the infra change in a local branch and re-run the test.
Marta: If revert looks noisy, consider using `--skip-integration` for now to unblock merge then follow up with infra fix — but note we prefer not to skip integration unless absolutely needed.
Tom: Agree. Also we could try doing a quick rebase onto main — some test flakiness was fixed in main yesterday.
Priya: Doing a rebase now. Pushing in 5.
CI-bot: PR 21041 updated with 1 new commit. CI triggered.
Tom: New run shows green on mac-e2e! All checks passed. :tada:
Priya: Nice. @Marta can you re-approve when you have a sec?
Marta: Approved. Please squash the fix commit, then you can merge. @releaseops — FYI about potential canary if we need it.
ReleaseOps-bot: Noted. Maintenance window 2026-03-19 22:00 UTC. If landing before that, please coordinate deploy team.
Priya: Squashed and merged. Thanks everyone. I'll monitor canary metrics for 30m and then promote if stable. Marking this thread resolved.
Tom: Thanks. :thumbsup:
